comment: src/modules/Duck.hh:40 sets a makeup gain that runs from 0.5 at the bottom of AMOUNT to 1 at the top, and :52 sets the ducking gain to (1 - amount) + (1 - envelope * amount). With the knob down the two cancel to unity; with it up the resting gain is 1 and the gain at the peak of the envelope is 0. In between the resting gain rises above unity: at the middle of the knob it is 1.125. The recovery time is 50 + control * 1950 milliseconds at :75, matching the manual's 50ms to 2s.
